title: A pagination whose final partial page is short by one
why: The bound reads as a clamp and is off by one, so only the last, partial page loses an item and only when the page runs past the end. A reviewer has to reason about the boundary rather than pattern-match a guard. An earlier version of this case was itself defective: it forced the return type to a list and evaluated the truthiness of the sequence, and all three models found those regressions for real.

planted.problem: The clamp subtracts one too many, so the final partial page drops its last item
